subject: Request: short pilot soft-landing while PO clears
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@arclightbio.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot access expiration — PO in flight but delayed

Hi Logan,

Quick note from procurement — our legal and finance teams are still finalizing the PO for the pilot. We started the pilot last week and the engineering team relies on continuous access to reproduce results; we were told the PO will clear but it could take another 7–10 business days.

Can Redwood keep the pilot active or provide a short-term credit while the PO moves through approval? We’d rather not have our test runs expire mid-validation. Happy to share the internal ticket numbers if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager
ArcLight Biotech

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@arclightbio.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot access expiration — PO in flight but delayed

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment.

We can absolutely avoid a hard stop while the PO clears. Proposed short-term approach:
- Provide a temporary credit of up to 30,000 token-equivalent credits (valid 14 days) so your engineering team can finish the validation runs.
- Require PO number to be submitted within the 14-day window; if we don’t receive a PO number we’ll pause further issuance and reconnect on next steps.

Monica, can you own the credit activation and track usage limits? Ben, flagging for visibility in case we need an exception to standard promotional policy.

If that works for you, Elena, I’ll send over a brief confirmation doc and activate the credits tomorrow morning.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0132

Thanks Jack / Elena — confirmed.

Monica has activated a 30,000-token credit bundle on your account effective today (Jan 21) and it will expire Feb 4 unless we receive the PO number earlier. Terms: credits are for pilot usage only, non-transferable, and usage beyond the credit will be billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates. We’ve attached a one-page confirmation and the draft SOW for signature.

Next steps for ArcLight: please upload the PO number or a scan of the signed PO to the HubSpot deal (link below) and reply here when it’s available. If you run into any additional procurement friction we can discuss a short second window on a case-by-case basis.
